ticket.current_state: The demo returns bounded JSON request logs without trace_id correlation.
ticket.desired_state: Valid synthetic request-context trace IDs appear in structured logs.
ticket.objective: Implement validated trace_id correlation by changing app.py only.
implementation_scope: Edit only app.py; test_app.py, acceptance.py and CI are immutable.
No packages, network calls, listeners, infrastructure or configuration changes.
acceptance_criteria: For GET /health, unknown routes and unsupported methods, preserve a valid trace_id exactly.
Valid means a string of exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not all zeroes.
Omit trace_id for absent, nonstring, uppercase, wrong-length, nonhex, all-zero or newline input.
Preserve response status/body, route sanitization and the event/route/status log fields.
Never log raw context, arbitrary headers, request bodies, raw paths or extra fields.
Run python acceptance.py: all seven tests must pass with no failures, errors or skips.
qa_requirements: Use the unchanged acceptance.py gate in the pinned network-disabled test container.
Confirm the baseline has exactly the expected missing-correlation failure.
telemetry_requirements: Verify synthetic JSON log correlation only; do not claim real telemetry export or service certification.
delivery_requirements: Open a draft PR against the explicitly configured demo base branch.
Record evidence and configured nonterminal Jira transitions; no merge or deployment.
ticket.rollback_strategy: Discard the unmerged candidate branch/PR after review; no running service is changed.
